result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Requisition Number: REQ672963
Employment Type: Casual
Position Classification: Enrolled Nurse
Remuneration: $36.73 - $39.91 per hour (+ super + casual loading)
Applications Close: 22 July 2026
Vaccination Category: A 
Located in: Various sites - Deniliquin, Urana, Hay, Jerilderie, Barham and Finley

Join a Team That's Making a Difference Across the Region.

About the Opportunity
Are you a Enrolled Nurse seeking a rewarding career in rural healthcare? 
The Deniliquin Cluster offers opportunities across Deniliquin, Barham, Urana, Hay, Finley and Jerilderie, providing diverse clinical experiences in acute, aged care, operating theatre and emergency settings. With a range of locations and specialties to choose from, you can find the role and lifestyle that best suits you while making a meaningful difference in regional communities.
From the rivers of Deniliquin and Barham to the wide-open landscapes of Hay, the community spirit of Urana, the family-friendly lifestyle of Finley and the rich heritage of Jerilderie, the cluster offers something for everyone. Spend your days off boating, fishing, kayaking, camping, golfing, exploring local history, enjoying community events, visiting caf s and markets, or simply embracing the relaxed pace of country life.

As the Enrolled Nurse, you will:

Deliver safe, person-centred, evidence-based nursing care

Assess, plan and evaluate care in collaboration with the Registered Nurse

Provide clinical care, education and health promotion

Build strong therapeutic relationships and work collaboratively within the multidisciplinary team

Recognise and respond to deterioration, escalating care as required

Support safe transitions of care and continuous improvement activities

Work within scope of practice, including delegated activities, and support AINs, students and learners

To find out more, please review the Position Description

About You
Our ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Current nursing registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)

The ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

Strong communication and interpersonal skills

A commitment to quality improvement, safety and professional development

The ability to adapt to changing models of care and evolving clinical practice

Confidence in supporting individuals with complex needs, including those exhibiting challenging behaviours

Why join MLHD

At Murrumbidgee Local Health District (MLHD), we offer more than a job, we offer the chance to make a real difference.

Make a Meaningful Impact - Play a vital role in delivering essential health services to our diverse and vibrant regional communities.

Attractive Remuneration - Enjoy competitive pay aligned with your skills and experience.

Generous Salary Packaging - Access up to $20,600 per annum tax-free for living expenses, plus the option for novated car leasing

Professional Development - Take advantage of ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

Health & Wellbeing Support - Benefit from our comprehensive wellness programs for you and your family, including Employee Assistance Programs, Fitness Passport, and initiatives to support both physical and mental health.

Click here to discover why MLHD is the right place to grow your career and contribute to healthier communities.

How to Apply 
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, click apply now! Please contact Contact Craig McColm ,Cluster Manager via, Craig.McColm@health.nsw.gov.au, if you have any questions about this role.

MLHD welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and is committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve. 
We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and the LGBTIQ+ community. 
If you identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander, you can access recruitment application support through the Stepping Up initiative.

result.description: Gardening Magicians Pty Ltd  Gardening Magicians Pty Ltd is seeking a reliable and hands-on Gardener (General) to join our growing team. The successful applicant will perform a senior gardening role and will be responsible for planning and carrying out a broad range of skilled gardening, planting and horticultural maintenance tasks across residential, commercial, councils, and client sites. The role will also involve providing day-to-day guidance and practical support to other gardeners and assistants.   Benefits   Stable, full-time employment.  Variety of work across different sites.  Supportive team environment with opportunities to develop your horticultural skills.  Competitive salary plus superannuation.    Task & responsibilities   Plan and undertake horticultural and garden maintenance tasks across residential and commercial sites.  Read and interpret garden maintenance plans, planting schedules and site instructions to ensure appropriate plant placement and completion of gardening work.  Prepare soil, garden beds and planting areas, and plant trees, shrubs, hedges, flowers, seeds, bulbs and lawns according to seasonal and site requirements.  Maintain planted and grassed areas by weeding, pruning, trimming, fertilising, watering and mowing to support healthy growth and presentation.  Identify and control weeds, pests and plant diseases using safe and approved chemical and manual methods.  Apply mulching, soil improvement and plant care techniques to enhance plant health and sustainability.  Safely operate and maintain horticultural hand and power tools and machinery (e.g. mowers, trimmers, blowers, hedge trimmers and chainsaws).  Follow all workplace health and safety procedures and maintain cleanliness of equipment and work sites.  Work collaboratively with other team members to meet work schedules, service requirements and client expectations.  Provide day-to-day guidance and on-the-job support to other gardeners and assistants to ensure tasks are completed safely, efficiently and to company standards.    Qualification & experience   A Certificate III in Horticulture or a closely related qualification  AT least 2 years of relevant work experience as a Gardener  Sound practical knowledge of plants, lawns, weeds, plant health and horticultural maintenance techniques.  Ability to safely use and maintain common gardening equipment and small machinery.  Ability to safely undertake physically demanding outdoor gardening work in varying weather conditions.  Strong attention to detail and pride in delivering neat, high-quality work.  Ability to follow instructions, work to schedules and complete tasks with minimal supervision.  A current driver’s licence is highly regarded.   About Company    Gardening Magicians Pty Ltd is a professional gardening, grounds maintenance and landscaping company delivering high-quality services to councils, commercial clients, civil contractors, schools, residential clients and large multi-site properties throughout South Australia.  Our team includes skilled gardeners, landscape gardeners and grounds maintenance workers who provide garden establishment, planting, lawn installation, landscaping and ongoing horticultural maintenance services.  We pride ourselves on safety, reliability, professionalism and consistently delivering high-quality results for our clients. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Gardener (General) to join our expanding team.
